ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Arun Kumar Saraf, a promoter of Asian Hotels (East) Limited, will acquire 11.72% of the company's shares (2,026,520 shares) from Mrs. Ratna Saraf via an inter-se gift transaction by September 30, 2026. This acquisition will increase the overall promoter group's shareholding from 42.19% to a controlling majority of 53.91%, significantly consolidating their ownership. The transaction is compliant with SEBI regulations, exempt from an open offer, and involves no cash consideration, thereby presenting no immediate red flags beyond a material shift in corporate control.
